change.title: Split read-only Doctor diagnostics from explicit Skill route repair
change.summary: Replaces the combined string-returning Doctor action with one canonical-config read-only diagnostic intent and one explicit HostBridge Skill route repair intent, each returning a typed result that the frontend renders without transaction chaining or message parsing.

basis: run_doctor_read_only uses the canonical-v4 read-only loader, rejects legacy schema instead of migrating it, and does not acquire a runtime mutation lease
the Doctor child clears inherited environment state, fixes canonical config and Science/Gateway paths, and forces real Science HOME inspection off even under hostile parent overrides
the read-only command runs only the existing redacted doctor shell and in-memory Codex diagnostic projection; it never invokes Skill route reconcile or starts Science/Gateway
repair_skill_route is a separate explicit Tauri command and the sole Doctor-area owner of the HostBridge mutation lease and force_third_party_reconcile
repair returns synchronized, deferred, restart-required, not-required, or warning as typed status while preserving the existing no-implicit-Science/Gateway-start boundary
the frontend maps each button to exactly one command and renders schema_version, intent, status, and message without chaining IPC or parsing diagnostic prose
focused Rust, Node, shell, metadata, inventory, boundary, document-governance, exact-SHA source gate, and clean-context review are required for source closure
artifact, installed, live provider/Science/SSH, signing, notarization, public release, Q0, O1-A, F1, and Post-D0 route selection remain excluded
